rationale: s2_q samples s1_q & en_dst_i, so logic sits between stages 1 and 2 of an asynchronous clk_a-to-clk_b chain: CDC-006 ERROR. Readers differed only in site order.

author_reading.rationale: Logic (AND with a destination-domain enable) sits between synchronizer stage 1 and stage 2.

labels.rationale: s2_q samples s1_q through an AND gate. en_dst_i is timed to clk_b, but the first-stage metastability path passes through logic before the next flop.

The asynchronous crossing from src_q (clk_a) into clk_b enters first stage s1_q (design.sv:17), but the path into second stage s2_q passes through combinational AND logic with en_dst_i (s2_q <= s1_q & en_dst_i at design.sv:18), violating inter-stage synchronizer integrity (CDC-006 ERROR Established).

settlement.rationale: s2_q samples s1_q & en_dst_i, so logic sits between stages 1 and 2 of an asynchronous clk_a-to-clk_b chain: CDC-006 ERROR. Readers differed only in site order.
